results.title: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes (2026): Pricing, Features & Reviews Compared
results.snippet: For mostly 1:1 virtual caseloads, all three work out of the box (with TheraNest requiring the add-on or Premier). For group telehealth, TherapyNotes’ Premium tier ($15/month) supports up to 16 participants; SimplePractice handles groups within its existing plans; TheraNest covers group sessions on Premier.

results.title: TheraNest Vs. SimplePractice: Comparison, Cost, & Key Features
results.snippet: After spending significant time using—and recently revisiting—SimplePractice and TheraNest, I’ve seen firsthand how they compare. If you want a plug-and-play EHR with strong automation and mobile-friendly features, SimplePractice is the better fit. If you need custom workflows, flexible pricing based on caseload, and more control over documentation, TheraNest is the way to go.

results.title: SimplePractice Vs. TherapyNotes: Comparison, Cost, & Key Features
results.snippet: However, SimplePractice is relatively expensive compared to some competitors. ... SimplePractice offers three subscription plans, starting at $49 monthly for solo practitioners and scaling up to $99 monthly for the Plus Plan, which is required for group practices. While the tiered pricing provides flexibility, the cost can climb quickly as many features are locked behind higher-tier plans or require add-on fees. By contrast, TherapyNotes follows a much simpler, clinician-based pricing model—starting at $59 monthly for solo providers and $69 monthly for the first clinician in a group practice, with each additional provider costing $40 per month.

results.title: SimplePractice vs TheraNest - 2026 Comparison
results.snippet: TheraNest is priced per therapist, per month. Their plans range from $26.58 up to $81.58, with free trials and demos available for every plan. There is also an offer in which users who sign up for an annual plan will get one month free. SimplePractice also has three pricing plans, each paid monthly.
